name: Silk Roads: Zarafshan-Karakum Corridor
description: This 866-kilometre stretch of the Silk Roads links Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan, running along the Zarafshan River from the mountains into fertile valleys. It then turns southwest across the Karakum Desert on old caravan routes to the Merv Oasis. Its 31 sites mark a crossroads where traders, settlers and armies met and mixed from the 2nd century BCE to the 16th century CE.
